component.name: Open Design
component.summary: Local-first AI design tool powered by your coding agent

description.p: Open Design is the open-source, local-first alternative to AI-powered design tools. It auto-detects installed coding agent CLIs on your PATH (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, GitHub Copilot CLI, and more) and uses them as the design engine.

ul.li: 31 composable Skills: prototype, deck, marketing, mobile, dashboard, PM spec, and more
72+ brand-grade Design Systems: Linear, Stripe, Vercel, Apple, Notion, Figma, and more
Streams design artifacts into a sandboxed preview with real-time progress
Export to HTML, PDF, PPTX, ZIP, or Markdown
Media generation: image, video, audio, and motion graphics
Local SQLite storage — all your projects and conversations stay on your machine
MCP server so other coding agents can read your design files directly
Upgraded the built-in OpenDesign Agent with sharper multimodal image handling and more reliable long-running sessions.
Added inline clarifying questions, AtomCode runtime support, a SiliconFlow Global BYOK preset, and parallel AMR web search.
Fixed HTML preview delivery, deck exports, BYOK agent failures, packaged startup, and update reliability.
Optimized the Design System Prompt for faster first responses, shorter end-to-end runs, and lower token use.
Improved deck navigation, speaker notes, presentation controls, exports, and website cloning from a URL.
Made task failures, stopping behavior, desktop recovery, localization, and library previews more reliable.

description.p: Added an opt-in silent update preference for applying downloaded updates the next time Open Design starts.
